Writing Sub-Test:            Nursing
Time allowed:                Reading time: 5 minutes
                             Writing time: 40 minutes

Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.


Notes

Patient History:                      Martin Wilson, 62, was admitted to Lyell McEwin Hospital 10 days
                                      ago after a suicide attempt involving an overdose of Mogodol. The
                                      patient will be discharged in three days time (18/9/08).
Past Medical History:                 History of bronchitis
                                      Heavy smoker
Social History/Supports:              Recently retired. Lives with wife, Joan, in housing trust maisonette
                                      in Elizabeth. 3 adult daughters and 5 grandchildren. Depression
                                      related to gambling addiction – he has lost a lot of money and is
                                      in debt. His wife and family previously unaware of addiction –
                                      angry but also upset about his suicide attempt.
                                      He is very remorseful and ashamed
                                      Wants to overcome addiction
Nursing Management:                   Weak and depressed. Anti-depressants prescribed – Lovan 200g
                                      BP 130/95
                                      BMI 19 – underweight
                                      Poor appetite
                                      Physically unfit



Writing Task

Using the information in the notes, write a letter to the social worker, Ms Jennifer Adams, at the
Elizabeth Community Health Centre requesting follow-up care. Stress that Mr Wilson’s case needs
urgent attention.

In your answer:

    •    expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences
    •    do not use note form
    •    use letter format

The body of the letter should be approximately 180-200 words.
